steps.title: Maintain BSR T7/5 Cell Culture
steps.instruction: Perform routine sub-passage of BSR T7/5 cells using tissue culture medium supplemented with Geneticin (500 μg/mL) as growth medium, adding Geneticin every passage.

steps.title: Prepare 6-Well Plates for Transfection
steps.instruction: Seed BSR T7/5 cells into 6-well plates one night before transfection.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate growth medium from a T75 flask.
Add 2 mL of trypsin-EDTA, rock the flask, and incubate at 37 °C and 5% CO2 for 2 minutes.
Once cells dislodge, add 8 mL of tissue culture medium and suspend cells using a pipet.
Count cells and seed 4.5x10^5 cells per well of a 6-well plate.
Incubate plates at 37 °C and 5% CO2.

steps.title: Prepare Transfection Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare the DNA and Lipofectamine 2000 complexes using a 3:1 ratio of Lipofectamine (μL) to plasmid/helper plasmid (μg).

substeps.instruction:
Dilute the following components with Opti-MEM to a final volume of 100 µL each: 
- RSV antigenome (NR-36460): 0.8 μg (8 μL of 0.1 μg/μL) + 92 μL Opti-MEM
- pA2-Lopt, L protein (NR-36461): 0.2 μg (2 μL of 0.1 μg/μL) + 98 μL Opti-MEM
- pA2-Nopt, N protein (NR-36462): 0.4 μg (4 μL of 0.1 μg/μL) + 96 μL Opti-MEM
- pA2-Popt, P protein (NR-36463): 0.4 μg (4 μL of 0.1 μg/μL) + 96 μL Opti-MEM
- pA2-M2-1opt, M2-1 protein (NR-36464): 0.4 μg (4 μL of 0.1 μg/μL) + 96 μL Opti-MEM
- Lipofectamine 2000: 6.6 μL + 93.4 μL Opti-MEM
Allow each dilution to sit at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Combine all six diluted components into one vial, mix gently, and incubate at room temperature for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Perform Cell Transfection
steps.instruction: Transfect the BSR T7/5 cells with the prepared mixture, ensuring a total volume of 600 µL per well.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate media from the 6-well plate.
Wash cells twice with 1 mL Opti-MEM per wash, aspirating the final wash.
Add 600 µL of the transfection mixture to each well.
Incubate the plate for 2 hours at room temperature on a low-speed shaker/rocker plate.
Add an additional 600 µL Opti-MEM per well.
Incubate the plate overnight (8-12 hours) at 37 °C and 5% CO2.

steps.title: Post-Transfection Incubation
steps.instruction: Replace transfection reagents with infection medium and continue incubation.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate and discard the transfection mixture from the wells.
Wash each well once with 1 mL sterile PBS.
Aspirate PBS and replace with 2 mL of infection medium - RSV per well (do not add Geneticin).
Incubate overnight at 37 °C and 5% CO2.

steps.title: Monitor and Passaged Cells
steps.instruction: Monitor cells for cytopathic effect (CPE) and maintain the culture.

substeps.instruction: Monitor for CPE (initially mini-syncytia, then rounded clumps of cells).
Sub-passage transfected cells into T25/T75 flasks when confluent (approximately every 48 hours).
Maintain cells in infection medium - RSV throughout the rescue process.

steps.title: Harvest and Store P0 Stock
steps.instruction: Harvest the virus once CPE is evident in >50% of the flask (typically ~7 days post-transfection).

substeps.instruction: Scrape T75 flasks and transfer contents to a 50 mL tube.
Spin at 1180 rpm for 5 minutes.
Remove most of the media and place it on ice; resuspend the cell pellet in approximately 2.5 mL of media.
Freeze/thaw the pellet 3 times, vortexing between each round.
Spin at 1180 rpm for 5 minutes.
Combine the media from the freeze/thaw cycles with the media previously placed on ice.
Aliquot into tubes, snap freeze, and store at -80 °C or colder to create the P0 stock.
